title: Serialize task-sync retirement and outcome settlement against the original Begin/Evaluate operation (G3, Engram side)
outcome: Serialize task-sync retirement and outcome settlement against the original Begin/Evaluate operation (G3, Engram side)
acceptance: Retirement or outcome reconciliation of a run with TermAl responsibility is serialized against the ORIGINAL Begin/Evaluate operation; a missing or not-found stored Begin outcome never retires it, proven by tests

Positively unsent intent can be retired only by its exact owner under the host fence; possibly-sent intent without server-side serialization or authoritative terminal settlement is retained and returned as pending, proven by tests
No elapsed time, crash, restart or Engram-only query is treated as proof of settlement, and recovery never dispatches a first execution
